name: Mari
summary: Mari is a casual acquaintance who repeatedly re-introduces himself every year or two. In 2022 he asked for a pricelist and mentioned trying to beat an iOS update, suggesting interest in phone unlock/jailbreak-type services. In Sept-Oct 2026 he resurfaced as a phone seller, offering roughly 8 iPhone 18 Pro 256GB units plus an 18 Pro Max 2TB (T-Mobile; blue, burgundy, black) because local shops were lowballing him. He is not a client of the three ALTR lines but may be a bulk iPhone supplier; last message was him answering carrier/color questions with no price agreed yet.
